title: DCPR 33(10) — Validation Assertions
check_types_supported: required           — source_value is present, non-empty, and > 0 (numeric) or non-empty string
expression         — arbitrary boolean over inputs/calcs (evaluated with a safe restricted evaluator)

checks.label: Gross plot area entered and positive
checks.recommended_action: Enter the gross plot area from the CTS / title records. Must be > 0.

checks.label: Development zone selected
checks.recommended_action: Choose Island City / Suburbs / Difficult Area — the base rehab-to-sale ratio depends on this.

checks.label: Primary road width ≥ 9 m
checks.recommended_action: Under DCPR 2034 a 9 m road is deemed sufficient for 33(10). For plots on narrower roads, verify with SRA.

checks.label: Eligible tenements entered and positive
checks.recommended_action: Complete the Slum Act Chapter I-B eligibility survey and enter the confirmed eligible count.

checks.label: Rehab carpet per tenement ≥ 25 sqm (statutory minimum)
checks.recommended_action: DCPR 33(10) VI 1.1 mandates minimum 25 sqm carpet area per rehab tenement. Increase the value.

checks.label: Rehab BUA loading factor in typical range 1.20 – 1.40
checks.recommended_action: Loading factor is outside the 1.20 – 1.40 industry-normal band. Verify with architect.

checks.label: Fungible % ≤ 35 (residential)
checks.recommended_action: Residential fungible compensatory area is capped at 35% per Reg 31(3). Reduce the value.

checks.label: Net plot area (after deductions) is positive
checks.recommended_action: Deductions exceed gross plot area — review the deduction inputs.

checks.label: Total deductions ≤ gross plot area
checks.recommended_action: Total deductions exceed gross plot area — check the inputs for double-counting.

checks.label: FSI Consumed In-Situ ≤ 4.0 (statutory in-situ cap)
checks.recommended_action: In-situ FSI consumption exceeds 4.0. Reduce sale-in-situ BUA and move balance to TDR (Reg 32).

checks.label: FSI Sanctioned > 4.0 — balance must go to TDR
checks.recommended_action: Sanctioned FSI exceeds the 4.0 in-situ cap. The excess is granted as TDR per Reg 32 and can be sold/utilized on receiving plots.

checks.label: Sale BUA proposed in-situ ≤ Max sale in-situ
checks.recommended_action: Proposed in-situ sale BUA exceeds the maximum that fits under the 4.0 FSI cap. Reduce it or move balance to TDR.

checks.label: Effective rehab-to-sale ratio ≤ 2.0 (sanity)
checks.recommended_action: Effective ratio above 2.0 is unusually high — verify zone and large-scheme incentive tier.

checks.label: Balance sale BUA (TDR) is non-negative
checks.recommended_action: Balance sale BUA turned negative — proposed in-situ sale exceeds sale entitlement. Check inputs.
